title: Monday Morning Quarterback
date_line: Thursday, Nov. 5, 2026. College Wednesday night review: Ball State at UMass, Toledo at Sacramento State and Central Michigan vs Eastern Michigan at Ford Field (Nov. 4), graded. Then the rest of the college week.

paragraphs: Wednesday night gave the MAC window three games, and one of them took overtime to settle every ticket on it. UMass −2.5 had first-and-goal at the Ball State 2 with a 4-point lead and came away with a field goal, Ball State tied it with 25 seconds left, and overtime came down to a missed extra point and a walk-off run. UMass won by 1 and lost the number by a point and a half. The same overtime turned a half-point Over sweat into a 12.5-point cash. Central Michigan vs Eastern Michigan was 35-0 until Eastern Michigan scored with 10 seconds left, and the Over 44.5 died 2.5 points short. Toledo vs Sacramento State never came near the 25.5.

Every game below is graded against the line printed on the card at kickoff, using ESPN finals and play-by-play, and a push counts as neither a hit nor a miss. The cards first went up Monday morning at UMass −3.5 with a total of 49.5, Sacramento State +25.5 with 52.5, and Eastern Michigan −1.5 with 44.5, with the Cover Writer on UMass −3.5, Sacramento State +25.5, Central Michigan +1.5 and the Over in all three. The Wednesday evening refreshes moved UMass to −2.5 and 48.5, bounced Sacramento State to +24.5 and back to +25.5, and flipped the Michigan game to Central Michigan −3, and the Cover Writer's side flipped with it to Eastern Michigan +3. The kickoff numbers are what's graded here. UMass and Sacramento State land the same at either number. Central Michigan +1.5 would have cashed by 29.5, but Eastern Michigan +3 was the side on the card at kickoff, and it lost by 25.

Follow The Money had no side in UMass vs Ball State or Toledo vs Sacramento State, and no total in the Michigan game. In The Trenches called the trenches even in Toledo vs Sacramento State, so it had no side there, and it reads sides only, so it had no total in any of the three. Letdown Watch made no picks Wednesday. None of those are graded.

Card line: UMass −2.5, total 48.5. The Cover Writer's card had UMass −2.5 and the Over, projecting UMass 31, Ball State 22. Final: Ball State 30, UMass 31. UMass won by 1 in overtime, and the teams scored 61 points.

UMass −2.5 was one touchdown from a cash with 4:48 to go. Watson hit Dia-Johnson for 47 yards to the Ball State 18, Kimmons ran 16 more to the 2, and UMass led 21-17 with first-and-goal. Kimmons got stuffed for no gain. Watson got stuffed for no gain. Then Watson fumbled, fell on it himself and lost 2 yards. Morris kicked a 23-yard field goal at 2:14 for a 24-17 lead. A touchdown there makes it 28-17. Instead UMass −2.5 was covering by 4.5, and the total sat at 41, 7.5 short of the Over 48.5, with Ball State getting the ball back.

Ball State went 75 yards in 1:49. Luster moved it to the UMass 24, and on a deep ball for Hamilton with 38 seconds left Magee got flagged for interference, a 15-yard gift down to the 9. Luster ran it in from 2 yards out with 25 seconds left, and Boehm's kick tied it at 24. UMass knelt on it. Regulation ended 24-24, the UMass side was back to needing a 3-point win, and the total sat at 48. Over 48.5 tickets were half a point short, Under 48.5 tickets were half a point from cashing, and in overtime the first points on the board would settle the total.

Ball State had the ball first. Luster found Hoover for 20 yards to the UMass 2, and Bonds got in from a yard out on the third snap from the 2. 30-24, 54 points, Over 48.5 cashed and Under 48.5 torn up. Then Boehm's extra point failed. Down 6, the most UMass could win by on its own possession was 2, with a touchdown and a two-point try, so the 2.5 was gone before UMass took a snap. Watson ran for 12, then 13 more for the touchdown, Morris hit the kick, and UMass won 31-30. UMass −2.5 lost by a point and a half, one goal-to-go series short of a cash.
Called it: In The Trenches on Ball State +2.5, covered by 1.5 points. The Cover Writer, The Formula and Next Man Up on the Over 48.5, cleared it by 12.5 points.
Missed: The Cover Writer, The Formula and Next Man Up on UMass −2.5, missed by 1.5 points. Follow The Money on the Under 48.5, went over by 12.5 points.
No pick: Follow The Money on the side; In The Trenches on the total.

Card line: Central Michigan −3, total 44.5. The Cover Writer's card had Eastern Michigan +3 and the Over, projecting Central Michigan 23, Eastern Michigan 22. Final: Central Michigan 35, Eastern Michigan 7. Central Michigan won by 28, and the teams scored 42 points.

Eastern Michigan +3 was finished by halftime. Glasser hit Williams from 8 yards out for a 7-0 Central Michigan lead, Woodford ran in from 11 and from 2 yards out, and it was 21-0 at the break. Woodford added a 1-yard run in the third, and Eastern Michigan +3 holders were down 28 with a quarter to go.

The Over 44.5 was the real sweat, and it needed Eastern Michigan to show up. Central Michigan made it 35-0 at 11:07 of the fourth after Horace got flagged for interference to put the ball at the 2, Eastern Michigan drew an unsportsmanlike flag and Blue ran it in from a yard out. 35 points with 11 minutes left, and the Over needed 10 more. Eastern Michigan drove to the Central Michigan 35, and Mattord got stopped for no gain on fourth down at 6:07.

Eastern Michigan got one more crack with under four minutes left and went 85 yards in 15 plays. Stuckey found Devereaux for what was ruled a 20-yard touchdown with 29 seconds left, and Central Michigan challenged and got it overturned to an incompletion. Eastern Michigan ran 14 yards to the 6, and Stuckey hit Mack from 6 yards out with 10 seconds left. 42 points, and Over 44.5 tickets needed 3 more with 10 seconds on the clock. Eastern Michigan kicked it deep for a touchback, Central Michigan took a knee, and the Over died 2.5 points short. The Eastern Michigan +3 side lost by 25.
Called it: Follow The Money on Central Michigan −2.5, covered by 25.5 points. In The Trenches on Central Michigan −3, covered by 25 points.
Missed: The Cover Writer, The Formula and Next Man Up on Eastern Michigan +3, missed by 25 points. The Cover Writer, The Formula and Next Man Up on the Over 44.5, fell 2.5 points short.
No pick: Follow The Money on the total; In The Trenches on the total.

items.matchup: College Wednesday · No sweat against the number

paragraphs: Card line: Toledo −25.5, total 52.5. The Cover Writer's card had Sacramento State +25.5 and the Over, projecting Toledo 38, Sacramento State 18. Final: Toledo 20, Sacramento State 17. Toledo won by 3, and the teams scored 37 points.

Sacramento State +25.5 never needed a sweat. Sacramento State led 10-7 at the half after Sharman hit Coleman from 2 yards out. Toledo went up 17-10 on Ison's 19-yard run late in the third and 20-10 on Griffith's 40-yard field goal at 7:51 of the fourth, and Curtis cut it to 20-17 from 3 yards out with 2:20 left. Sacramento State got the ball back at its own 16 with 55 seconds left, Lambert-Pipkin sacked Salazar for 10 yards, and the last throw, for Smith Jr., got broken up by Petite on fourth down. Sacramento State +25.5 cashed by 22.5 and finished 3 points from winning the game outright.

The Over 52.5 was dead long before that. 17 points at the half, 37 at the end, and the Over came up 15.5 short. Follow The Money's Under 52.5 was the one total on the board Wednesday that never had a scare.
Called it: The Cover Writer, The Formula and Next Man Up on Sacramento State +25.5, covered by 22.5 points. Follow The Money on the Under 52.5, stayed under by 15.5 points.
Missed: The Cover Writer, The Formula and Next Man Up on the Over 52.5, fell 15.5 points short.
No pick: Follow The Money on the side; In The Trenches on the side or the total.

hits.heading: Part 1, continued: The week's W-L and smack talk

paragraphs: The Cover Writer went 1-2 against the spread and 1-2 on totals Wednesday, and that makes the week 2-3 on both. Sacramento State +25.5 and the UMass Over were the cashes. UMass −2.5 died on a goal-to-go series that ended in a field goal, the Michigan game flipped the card to Eastern Michigan +3 before kickoff and the flip lost by 25, and the Over 44.5 came up a field goal short.

The Formula went 1-2 on sides and 1-2 on totals Wednesday, 3-2 and 2-3 for the week. The Formula matched the Cover Writer ticket for ticket Wednesday, flip included, and lost the same four. It still owns the better side record for the week, and it will bring that up.

Next Man Up went 1-2 on sides and 1-2 on totals Wednesday, 2-3 and 2-3 for the week, the exact same record as the Cover Writer. Two nights in, Next Man Up hasn't split from the Cover Writer on a single ticket. Pick a lane.

Follow The Money went 1-0 on sides and 1-1 on totals Wednesday, 2-0 and 2-2 for the week. Central Michigan −2.5 cashed by 25.5 and the Under 52.5 cashed by 15.5. The Under 48.5 was half a point from a cash at the end of regulation, and overtime blew it out by 12.5.

In The Trenches went 2-0 on sides and made no total picks Wednesday, and it is 4-0 on sides for the week. Ball State +2.5 got there by a point and a half and Central Michigan −3 by 25. In The Trenches and Follow The Money are the only two handicappers without a side loss this week, and In The Trenches has twice as many wins.
Letdown Watch made no picks Wednesday or Tuesday.
